title: "WARNING python3: :- operator(): DB '{APPL_DB}' is empty with pattern '_GEARBOX_TABLE:phy:*'!" is generated for "show interface status/counters"
author: gechiang
body:
**Description**

Whenever user issue "show interface counters" or "show interface status", a warning message similar to the following is logged in syslog:
```
Dec 28 20:12:13.556771 str-s6100-acs-2 WARNING python3: :- operator(): DB '{APPL_DB}' is empty with pattern '_GEARBOX_TABLE:phy:*'!
```
perhaps the handler should add handling of cases where such DB entry is not expected for the given platform/SKU and not blindly issue requests thinking that it will always be there which result to these syslog warning messages...

"sonic-utilities/scripts/gearboxutil"  seems to be the handler that is causing the above issue.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. on an ssh session logged on to the DUT run the following cmd "sudo tail -f /var/log/syslog" 
2. On a different ssh session of the same DUT Issue CLI cmd "show interface counters" or "show interface status"
3. Observe the warning message gets logged into syslog each time the CLI is executed.

**Describe the results you expected:**
There should not be such warning logged into syslog.  Better handling should be made to avoid trigger unnecessary warning/error logging onto the syslog.

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

    **Output of `show version`:**
```
admin@str-s6100-acs-2:~$ show vers

SONiC Software Version: SONiC.HEAD.191-9c06df8e
Distribution: Debian 10.7
Kernel: 4.19.0-9-2-amd64
Build commit: 9c06df8e
Build date: Mon Dec 28 01:33:12 UTC 2020
Built by: johnar@jenkins-worker-22
```

comments.body:
Dear @gechiang, @lguohan

I have investigated the issue.
The root cause of the issue is https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/blob/master/show/main.py#L166.
The checking of gearbox is being performed each time you calls show command, so, it explains why the warning occurs so often.
I have made PR with fix of the issue and some additional changes. Could you check it? 
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/pull/1343

linkedPullRequests.title: [show] Fix warnings, related to gearbox, while show commands execution
linkedPullRequests.body:
* Performing getting from APPL_DB of all the keys while checking readiness
  status of the gearbox to prevent warnings sending to syslog if there no 
  records of PHYs of a gearbox in APPL_DB.
* Moving of the gearbox readiness status checking procedure to separated
  function.

Signed-off-by: Maksym Belei <Maksym_Belei@jabil.com>

**- What I did**
1. Resolves https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6311.
Occurrence of the next warnings while performing show commands has fixed:
`Jan 29 15:05:50.705534 sonic WARNING python3: :- operator(): DB '{APPL_DB}' is empty with pattern '_GEARBOX_TABLE:phy:*'!`;

**- How I did it**
The issue has fixed by getting of all the keys from APPL_DB, before checking of presence of _GEARBOX_TABLE:phy:* records in the DB.

**- How to verify it**
1. open two terminal sessions with the DUT;
2. perform command "sudo tail -f /var/log/syslog | grep operator" in the first session;
3. perform command "show interface counters" or "show interface status" in the second session;
4. verify the the warning, described above is not occurred in the first CLI session.
